tips.text: Farm the three Argon Crystals only once all eight Fieldron are built or about to finish, because Argon decays at the daily reset.
Buy a stack of Fieldron blueprints at once and keep the foundry queue full; each blueprint is used up by its build.
Join a clan whose Energy Lab already researched the Amprex; a fresh clan waits at least 12 days.
Getting it is easy and the 12-hour Fieldron builds are the only annoyance; do every Corpus Invasion and one Vallis bounty rotation and it takes a few days.
Most players build it for Mastery and nostalgia rather than as a main weapon.
